data.description:
HEADLINE:
Job Title: VP Partnerships
Reporting to: Chief Commercial Officer
Location: London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

ABOUT THE ROLE:
APEXX is pioneering payment orchestration, transforming the global payments landscape with cutting-edge technology and innovation. As a leader in Fintech, we're committed to excellence, driving forward-thinking solutions that empower businesses worldwide.

We are looking for an experienced VP of Partnerships to lead APEXX's global partnerships strategy and drive sustainable revenue growth through strategic alliances across the payments ecosystem.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for identifying, negotiating and growing commercial partnerships that expand APEXX's market reach, strengthen our product offering and create new revenue opportunities. You will own relationships with payment providers, acquiring banks, card schemes, financial institutions, and strategic industry stakeholders, ensuring APEXX continues to build a best-in-class global payments network.

Reporting directly to the CCO, you will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Customer Success to develop partnership strategies that accelerate customer acquisition, increase transaction volume and support APEXX's international growth ambitions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Strategy & Partner Enablement:

  • Develop and execute APEXX's global partnerships strategy, aligned with the company's commercial objectives and growth plans.

  • Identify strategic opportunities that drive recurring revenue growth, expand market reach and strengthen APEXX's competitive position.

  • Build and maintain an ecosystem of high-value partnerships that support long-term business growth.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the COO and Executive Leadership Team on partnership strategy, market opportunities and industry trends.

Revenue Growth:

  • Deliver measurable commercial outcomes through strategic partnerships that generate new revenue streams and increase payment volumes.

  • Identify, negotiate and execute commercial agreements that create mutual value for APEXX and its partners.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to develop partner-led growth initiatives and joint go-to-market programmes.

  • Create scalable partnership models that accelerate customer acquisition and market expansion.

Partner Relationship Management:

  • Own executive relationships with acquirers, banks, payment schemes, alternative payment providers, fintechs and strategic technology partners.

  • Represent APEXX at executive meetings, industry forums, conferences and customer engagements.

  • Strengthen APEXX's reputation within the global payments community and identify opportunities to influence industry direction.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations with senior stakeholders across global organisations.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Partner with Product leadership to shape the strategic roadmap based on market demand and partner capabilities.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Delivery teams to prioritise integrations that maximise commercial value.

  • Collaborate with Marketing on joint campaigns, thought leadership and co-marketing initiatives.

  • Ensure partnerships deliver measurable business outcomes through effective governance, performance tracking and continuous optimisation.

Market & Industry Leadership:

  • Monitor market developments, competitive activity, regulatory changes and emerging payment technologies.

  • Identify opportunities for new strategic alliances, product innovation and international expansion.

  • Provide market intelligence and commercial insight to influence business strategy and investment priorities.

ABOUT YOU:

  • Significant leadership experience in strategic partnerships, business development or commercial leadership within Payments, FinTech or Financial Services.

  • Proven track record of delivering revenue growth through strategic partnerships and commercial alliances.

  • Deep understanding of the global payments ecosystem, including acquiring, orchestration, card schemes, alternative payment methods and financial infrastructure.

  • Strong executive network across banks, payment providers, fintechs, technology partners and industry organisations.

  • Demonstrated success negotiating complex, high-value commercial agreements with enterprise organisations.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate partnerships into measurable business outcomes.

  • Exceptional executive presence with outstanding communication, influencing and negotiation skills.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Executive Leadership teams.

  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to identify emerging market opportunities.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.

🏖️ Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.*

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance which includes optical & dental to help support you when it matters most.

🛡️ Life Insurance & Critical Illness Protection: Additional protection for you and your loved ones when it’s needed most.

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE:

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration.

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below:

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apexxglobal/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/apexx.global/?hl=en

Main Website: https://apexx.global/

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies.

data.title: Lab Operations Manager
data.description:
About Substrate

Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem: biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment, and the large-scale, high-quality data they need does not exist. We are building the lab that generates it, with quality and provenance built in. We are not a CRO and we are not a cloud lab.

The company was founded by Mostafa ElSayed, co-founder and CEO; Oli Hoy, who leads the lab buildout and operations; Alexey Morgunov, who leads science and intelligence software; and Anna Huyghues-Despointes, who leads partnerships and go-to-market.

The role

You will run the day-to-day operations of our lab in London, and be the person the scientists come to when something is missing, broken, late or lost. The day-one work is what you would expect: consumables and stock, goods in and cold chain, equipment servicing and calibration, suppliers and purchasing, waste streams and safety records.

Three parts go beyond a standard lab operations job. The first is provenance. Every experiment we sell carries a record of what went into it, down to the lot of the consumable used and the conditions material was held in. If a lot number is not captured, the data point is worth less, and that record runs through you.

The second is that the systems are not written yet. Inventory, goods in, asset registers and ordering exist in no form that will survive the next year. You define what the lab has to capture and work with the science and software teams to make sure it does.

The third is that sample handling and stock control here get automated, and you help specify the system that does it. Every sample, plate, reagent and consumable lot carries a barcode, scanned at each point it is handled, so the record is created by the work rather than reconstructed afterwards. The same scan draws stock down, which turns reordering from a weekly count into something the system flags before anyone is short. Our software team is building that layer now and the requirements have to come from the lab floor: what gets a barcode, where the scan points sit, and what happens when a label will not read. Some find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing which one you are.

Your first 90 days

First 30 days

  • Take ownership of goods in: every delivery received, booked in, stored correctly and recorded.

  • Map how material moves through the lab and build the first accurate picture of what we hold. That map is the input to a fully barcoded scheme and system.

Days 30 to 60

  • Put a working inventory and reorder system in place, with minimum levels set from real consumption rather than guesses, and own the purchasing loop.

  • Agree the barcode and labelling scheme with the software team, and get equipment records in one place.

Days 60 to 90

  • Run the lab as a routine that does not depend on being asked, with the barcoded system live across one workflow, goods-in to bench to stock draw-down, feeding our provenance record.

Who you are

You have run the physical side of a lab where being out of stock stops the work: biotech, pharma, a university or institute lab, or a manufacturing or diagnostics operation built around one. Lab consumables and the rhythm of a working lab are already familiar to you, you have handled real volume and real inventory, and you know the difference between a system that works on paper and one that works at eight on a Monday morning. We are not asking for a particular speciality, but you should arrive able to run the lab rather than learn what one needs.

Must have:

  • Two or more years running a lab or comparable physical operation, hands-on and accountable for the result.

  • Practical stock control: goods in, inventory records, reorder points, stock counts that reconcile.

  • Buying from suppliers: raising orders, comparing quotes, managing lead times.

  • Hands-on with a barcoded or scanned stock system, including what goes wrong when people skip the scan.

  • Lab environment experience: cold storage, hazardous waste, containment, controlled materials.

Nice to have:

  • Health and safety training such as IOSH.

  • Developed or co-developed a barcode system for autonomous workflows in labs, including working with software development teams to implement it.

How we work and who you will work with

This role is on site five days a week at 20 Triton Street in London, because the lab is a physical place and the work is in it. The wider founding team is distributed across London, New York and Europe. You will report to Simon Varzandeh, a member of our scientific staff working on protein characterisation and one of the lab's heaviest users, and work alongside the protein science and functional genomics teams, the engineers building the tracking and stock system with you, and operations on facilities, health and safety and purchasing. You will be the first person here whose whole job is focused on the lab floor.

We work in the open and each person owns their area. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover.

Our process and how to apply

Four stages: a short screening call; a conversation about how you work, before anything technical; a practical exercise from our lab setup, sent separately, then a discussion of what you did and why; then references.

We are sharing this role through our network first. Send a note and your CV to ----- and if you are not sure whether you are a fit, send it anyway.

Substrate is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background.

data.description:
We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer to own the data foundation our AI agents run on.

Procurement data is messy: ERP transactions, contracts, spreadsheets, PDFs and email, spread across systems that were never designed to talk to each other. You'll build the ingestion pipelines and schemas that turn that into something autonomous agents can reason over, and set the quality and lineage standards that make it trustworthy enough for a Fortune 500 to act on.

We’ve built the early foundations but there’s still plenty to build - you’ll shape the architecture to serve hundreds of enterprise customers.

We're building next-generation agentic systems that can manage entire procurement workflows, with a mission to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient to an ever-changing world. That's a $3tn market opportunity.

We're backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, and you'll be joining a team bringing together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement and operate ingestion pipelines processing high-volume data from global supply chain and procurement systems.

  • Define, evolve, and manage data schemas and catalogues—from raw staging to high-quality analytics and feature stores.

  • Build end-to-end monitoring and observability for your pipelines: owning data quality, latency, completeness, and lineage at every stage.

  • Champion secure, governed data practices

  • Collaborate closely with AI, Platform, and Product teams, provisioning data sets, feature tables, and contracts for analytics and machine learning at scale.

You Might Be a Great Fit if You:

Solution Consulting is not an established playbook you're stepping into. You're building it. You'll decide how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows. You won't be stepping into someone else's playbook. You'll be shaping the entire GTM motion for our most important market.

You'll own & define the technical and business case throughout the sales cycles - from discovery through demo(s), supporting RFPs, and defining the solution approach.   • Work hand in hand with Product: Bring competitive intelligence and prospect insight back from the field, and work with Product to shape what we build and how we position it.


What's Different About This Role

  • This is a career-defining chance to help build Omnea's GTM and Solution Consulting function from the ground up in the U.S., at a company that's still writing its playbook rather than handing you one.

  • You'll own complex enterprise deals end to end, working directly with AEs and senior customer stakeholders, which means you'll influence not just how individual deals get won but how the entire Solution Consulting function operates as it scales.

  • We're a flat, high-bar team where senior hires are expected to be self-directed from day one: you won't be eased in with a slow ramp or a junior support structure, you'll be trusted with real ownership immediately.

  • The company is on an incredibly strong growth trajectory with enterprise momentum behind it, which means the scope for you to create visible, immediate impact is significant rather than incremental.

  • Expect a genuinely meritocratic culture, one with high standards and direct feedback, where performance is recognized quickly and equity upside reflects the level of ownership and impact you actually have.

About you

Someone who thrives in this role is highly ambitious, genuinely energized by ambiguity and wants to influence how this function works from the ground up. They're also an exceptional individual contributor first: whatever they've been trusted with before, they've delivered on it.

data.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Bidding
data.description:
Staff Machine Learning Engineer – Ads Bidding

The Team

The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product — connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours).

The Problem

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. This is a genuinely open, cutting-edge problem: very few companies have solved it, and there's no established playbook to follow. The exact approach is under active discussion and you'd be central to driving it.

You will:

  • Own the design and execution of the CPC-to-CPO migration, including the core open question of whether the system stays CPO-facing externally while optimising CPC behind the scenes, or some hybrid of the two

  • Build and improve the bidding surface: goal-based automated bidding, Target CPO, optimised CPC, and Target ROAS

  • Own yield management tied to ROS targeting

  • Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

  • Set technical direction for the domain

Requirements

  • Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

  • Direct working experience with optimised CPC, target CPO, goal-based automated bidding, and target ROAS

  • Strong self-driven leadership baseline — you'll be setting direction in an ambiguous space, not executing against an established one

  • 7+ years writing production code in Python; solid ML fundamentals in ranking, recommendation systems, or bidding/auction systems

data.description:
About Fyxer

Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

 

We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who uses research, data, and experimentation to drive better bets, faster learning, and stronger commercial outcomes. We’re not looking for someone to write specs and hand over insights. We want someone who helps us think better and decide better.

You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain alongside our product, growth and leadership teams.


The Role

You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain / category design alongside our product / growth and leadership teams.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signals quickly, making informed decisions, and learning fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening thinking as you go.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes and a fullstack background around A/B experimentation and everything that comes with it.

 
 

What you will own:

You will own the quality of our product bets and the speed at which we learn.

  • Turn ambiguity into direction. Take messy signals from customers, product data, and the market and translate them into clear problem framing and product strategy.

  • Work directly with engineers. You will partner closely with engineers and founders from the start of an initiative, shaping solutions together rather than handing over specs.

  • Use the right tools to validate ideas and reduce risk: interviews, prototypes, experiments, product analytics, fake doors, usability testing, and behavioural analysis

  • Ship, learn, and iterate quickly. Move product bets from idea to shipped product to measurable outcomes, continuously tightening the loop between learning and building.

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team by coaching others, introducing scalable frameworks, and helping the team stay close to customers

 
 

Who You Are

  • Expert: You are an expert in your domain specialization that everyone could learn from including our other PM’s

  • Systems thinker: You understand customer journeys, funnels, and feedback loops. You connect user behaviour to outcomes and revenue impact, not just isolated features.

  • Engineering partner: You work closely with engineers and founders, translating user insight into clear problem framing and practical tradeoffs. You influence what we build through evidence and clarity.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there is enough signal to move. You help others clarify thinking, sharpen hypotheses, and make confident calls under uncertainty.

  • Capability builder: You design product systems that compound over time rather than one off projects. Your work levels up how we do product and discovery across the company, and you introduce frameworks, coach others, and build repeatable learning loops.

 

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Scope: This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage..

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

data.title: Operations Coordinator
data.description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Operations Coordinator

As Neara scales globally, we're investing in the operational backbone that keeps a fast-moving, high-growth team running smoothly. To that end, we are hiring an Operations Coordinator for our London office: a hybrid role covering day-to-day administration, finance and customer invoicing support, team travel and activities, local HR requirements, onboarding, and hands-on support for commercial and marketing document work.

This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who thrives on variety and detail, and who can move seamlessly between supporting an executive's calendar and inbox, keeping the finance and invoicing wheels turning, and pulling together a tender submission or marketing document. You will be the connective tissue that keeps the London/Europe team organised, compliant, and moving fast.

What You'll Do:

  • Act as a trusted right hand to regional leadership and team, anticipating needs and proactively solving problems before they become issues.

  • Manage day-to-day administrative operations for the London/Europe team, including calendars, correspondence, and general executive support.

  • Support financial administration - expense processing, invoice tracking, and liaising with finance at HQ.

  • Own the customer invoicing process for the region: raising invoices, tracking payment status, chasing outstanding payments, and resolving billing queries.

  • Organise team travel, offsites, and team activities, ensuring cost-effective and smooth logistics.

  • Manage local HR requirements for the London/Europe team, including contracts, benefits administration, compliance with UK/EU employment regulations, and acting as first point of contact for HR queries.

  • Coordinate basic onboarding for new hires: equipment, access, welcome logistics, and initial paperwork.

  • Support the commercial team with tender or proposal submissions, and support marketing with collateral, event registrations, and vendor/supplier registrations.

Who You Are:

  • Experience in an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Office Manager, or similar operations role, ideally in a fast-growing scale-up.

  • Comfortable working across finance, HR, and admin tasks, with strong attention to detail.

  • Experience with invoicing/billing processes and basic bookkeeping (Xero preferred).

  • Familiarity with UK/EU employment and HR requirements, or a willingness to quickly get up to speed.

  • Strong written communication skills - comfortable producing polished documents, proposals, and submissions.

  • Highly organised, proactive, and able to juggle competing priorities

  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling sensitive information.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous and international environment where processes are still being built.

What We Offer:

  • A collaborative, non-bureaucratic environment where innovation thrives and great ideas win regardless of title.

  • Direct exposure to regional leadership, finance, HR, and commercial teams, putting you at the heart of our European operations.

  • The freedom to shape your role, build processes from the ground up, and directly enable our team to expand globally.

  • The opportunity to power a fast-growing tech scale-up that is actively helping solve world-scale climate resilience and grid challenges.

#LI-NT1 #LI-DNP

Compensation: £55K – £60K • Offers Equity

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the team

Lendable is the UK market leader in real rate risk-based pricing, offering consumers transparency and product assurance at the point of application. Data Science and Analytics sits at the heart of this, developing the credit risk models and strategies to underwrite loan and credit card products.

Our team is primarily focused on the pricing domain but we also work on other areas including product and credit. We implement a range of machine learning techniques and analytical tools to continually improve our product offering.

About the role

You will be working in the UK Loans team at Lendable and will work on projects related to pricing, funnel and credit optimisation in collaboration with the credit and product teams.

Join us if you want to

  • Work in a small, high-impact team where you will be mentored to solve complex analytical problems, eventually taking ownership of your own models

  • Be resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Work closely with other members of the team that will support developing your technical expertise and domain knowledge

Our team's objectives

  • The pricing team owns the loans funnel analytics and pricing strategy

  • We work across the business in a multidisciplinary capacity to identify issues, translate business problems into data questions, analyse and propose solutions

How you'll impact those objectives

  • Learn the domain of products that Lendable serves, understanding the data that informs strategy and modelling is essential to being able to successfully contribute value

  • Research and propose improvements to our existing pricing strategies and modelling methodology

  • Work closely with the credit team to align pricing decisions with credit risk and underwriting strategy

  • Clearly communicate results to stakeholders through verbal and written communication

  • Share ideas with the wider team, learn from and contribute to the body of knowledge

Key Skills

  • Theoretical understanding of core ML techniques and statistical principles

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, comfortable working with large datasets

  • Confident communicator and contributes effectively within a team environment

  • Self-driven and willing to take ownership of specific tasks and analyses

  • 1-2 years' experience in a technical, analytical or data-focused role

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to credit risk or financial datasets

  • Interest in Data Engineering

  • Prior experience with financial or pricing modelling

data.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups)

  • Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner

  • A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels

  • Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment

  • Proactive and collaborative approach

  • A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture

Compensation & Benefits

Finance & Insurance

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped)

  • Private health insurance with dental and vision

Time Off

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months per year

  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company-wide events

Location: London (hybrid)

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

data.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As a Senior Data Scientist at Hims & Hers, you are a core driver of technical execution and innovation within our data organization. You take complex business challenges and translate them into robust, scalable data products and machine learning models. You will be trusted to operate with high autonomy, owning your projects from the initial exploratory analysis through to production deployment.

In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize our operations, refine our marketing efforts, and enhance the customer experience. You will not only build powerful models but also help uphold the engineering rigor and standards of our data team.

You Will:

  • Build from Scratch: Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment. You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write complex SQL, engineer your own features, and deploy baseline models (heuristics or simple ML) quickly to prove value before iterating toward complex solutions.

  • End-to-End Execution: Own the complete model lifecycle, from data extraction and feature engineering to deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to define technical requirements and translate model outputs into clear, actionable business insights.

  • Uphold Technical Standards: Write clean, modular, and production-ready code. Actively participate in peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical best practices.

  • Drive Project Delivery: Navigate technical ambiguity within your domain, breaking down complex project requirements into manageable, executable milestones.

  • Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and support to junior data scientists and analysts, helping them troubleshoot roadblocks and adopt best practices.

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years of applied experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, with a track record of delivering production-ready models that drive measurable business value.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Python and SQL. Deep familiarity with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and standard ML frameworks (such as PyTorch, XGBoost, or LightGBM).

  • Engineering Rigor: Proven ability to build for production. Experience working in cloud-based environments (AWS or GCP) and familiarity with CI/CD workflows, version control (Git), and ML Ops principles.

  • Analytical Problem Solving: Strong ability to connect technical metrics to business outcomes. You know how to choose the right algorithm for the right problem rather than just the most complex one.

  • Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Education: BS, MS, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, Applied Math, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 0-to-1 Execution: Experience taking the very first machine learning models in an organization from exploratory notebooks to reliable, automated production pipelines.

  • Advanced Business ML (Experience in 1-2 of the following):

    • Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: Building predictive models for churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) to directly drive targeted marketing and product interventions.

    • Applied Forecasting: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or handling non-stationary data for demand or revenue planning.

    • Optimization: Building engines for marketing spend, inventory management, or resource allocation.

    • Causal Inference: Designing robust experiments (e.g., quasi-experiments, difference-in-differences) to measure true business impact beyond standard A/B testing.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

data.title: Support Engineering Manager
data.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be joining Primer's Product Support team, reporting to our Support Lead. Support here isn't a cost centre bolted onto the side of the business — it sits inside Engineering as a full discipline, working alongside the developers who ship Primer's platform. Primer's customers are payments-technical merchants and partners, so the team spends its time in APIs, SDKs, and integration logs as much as in a ticket queue.

The team runs 24/7 across Asia, Europe, and North America, and has grown to the point where one manager can no longer run it alone — which is why this role exists. You and our Support Lead will co-own Support's KPIs, metrics, and processes day-to-day. We run a deliberately low-ego, high-trust team — no dictated training plans, no micromanagement. You're joining at a genuinely interesting moment: due to the team's strong results and delivery on all our KPIs (especially Escalation Ratio and CSAT of 4.8/5), the team is about to expand into new territory as we expand the functions, partners and merchants that we support, so there's real room to shape where we go next.

What will you be doing?

  • Co-own Support's day-to-day KPIs, metrics, and processes, with direct accountability for your own group of Support Engineers. Step in when others are not available.

  • Manage and coach a growing team of 5 Support Engineers spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas — their delivery, growth, and performance.

  • Drive operational excellence. Hold the team to a consistent bar on quality and pace. Perform QA, and review proposals and RFCs.

  • Stay technically credible — dig into APIs, SDKs, and logs yourself, and step in to cover the team during periods of high demand, and on escalations.

  • Own triage, escalation, and incident processes for your team, including leading and communicating through severe incidents and their post-mortems.

  • Hold the team to a consistent quality and pace bar — review work, and coach rather than just monitor.

  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to surface recurring issues, shape a realistic roadmap, and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Identify knowledge and skill gaps across the team and facilitate the training to close them.

  • Report on support performance and initiatives to Product & Engineering leadership, with real visibility across the company.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years managing people, running a 24/7, distributed support operation — this is the one piece of experience that's essential for us

  • Technical enough to still debug an API integration or work through logs yourself, not just manage people who do.

  • A steady, consistent operator — someone reliable day in day out, not just on their best days.

  • Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to the wider company.

  • Experience managing a major incident through to a post-mortem and RCA.

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems like Jira, JSM, or Zendesk, and with ITSM and reporting/BI solutions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • 1-2 years in payments, or a strong B2B/SaaS background as a substitute.

You may not like it here

  • Support here isn't always exciting — you're managing people who spend their day in a ticket queue, looking at issues, troubleshooting and investigating. Time is of the essence.

  • You'll be expected to still do the job yourself when it's busy — reviewing logs, digging into an API issue, especially on escalations or incidents — not just delegate and report up.

  • Consistency is graded harder here than almost anywhere else.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

(Senior) Software Engineer - Data Integration Focus - Remote (m/f/d)
data.description:
At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands.

 

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

You’ll work hands-on, shipping production integrations. As the integration surface grows, you’ll shape the architecture, standards, and processes that keep integration work scalable.

 
 

What you'll do

Build integrations that unlock Luna’s next capabilities

  • Design and implement read/write integrations into third-party practice management systems

  • Design infrastructure that scales to hundreds of thousands of individual practice servers

  • Engineer reliability into the system: data consistency, idempotency, retries, error handling, observability

  • Triage integration failures in production, communicate impact clearly, and harden the system so the same class of failure doesn’t repeat

Make integration a scalable capability

  • Define technical standards and architecture for integrations

  • Establish pragmatic processes for development, maintenance, and incident handling

 

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, TypeScript and/or Rust

  • Proven experience building and running software in production

  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, distributed systems, and failure modes

  • Comfort operating in messy environments (inconsistent behavior, missing docs, etc.)

  • Clear communication under pressure (during incidents, vendor issues, competing priorities)

  • Excited to work in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have

  • Prior work on healthcare software or practice management systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, terminology, or data standards (e.g. FHIR)

  • Fluent German (spoken and written)

  • Experience in startups or scale-ups

 

Location & compensation

  • Location: Remote

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and participation in our VSOP program

  • Team bonding: Regular get-togethers, happy hours and offsites

  • Health and productivity: Urban Sports Club subscription

 

If you want to shape the next generation of healthcare software with us, apply now.

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

What you will be doing

The Head of Brand Marketing ensures that Faculty looks, sounds and shows up like the category leader it is: through a distinctive brand, a body of storytelling with a genuine point of view, a library of sharp assets that bring to life the exceptional work of our teams, and a marketing plan that is tightly aligned to Faculty’s business plan and strategic intent. It is delivered with a standard of craft that means nothing about Faculty ever feels accidental.

Strategic Responsibilities

This role has two core mandates:

1. Brand Strategy & Differentiation

You will be the primary custodian of the Faculty brand. Differentiating and elevating Faculty is a core strategic priority: you will position the company as the clear leader in applied AI, building reputation through bold, opinionated storytelling rather than the vague futurism that dominates so much of AI marketing.

2. Marketing Strategy & Delivery

You will co-create Faculty’s marketing strategy with the Director of Marketing and Communications, and develop and own the marketing plan that brings it to life, in line with Faculty's overall business plan and strategic intent.

You will hold the bar for excellence in marketing delivery: every asset matches the premium feel of our brand, every campaign is executed with purpose and precision, every narrative is crisp and intentional.

You will oversee events, digital, creative and content, making sure everything we produce is sharp, crisp, high quality and unmistakably Faculty.

Key Deliverables:

Brand & Narrative

  • Primary custodian of the Faculty brand

  • Foundational assets: corporate and commercial narratives, brand guidelines, case studies, canonical assets, ensuring central assets are culturally sensitive and travel well

  • Faculty differentiation: build Faculty’s reputation as a leader in applied AI through powerful storytelling about our work and opinionated perspectives on applied AI

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and own the marketing plan, ensuring it is tightly aligned to the business plan and able to flex as priorities shift.

  • Sit as a core member of the Marketing Leadership Team, shaping decisions that affect the wider function and bringing a brand and marketing lens to the leadership table.

  • Use data and audience insight to prioritise investment, favouring durable brand equity and growth over vanity metrics.

Marketing Delivery

  • Ensure every asset matches the premium feel of the Faculty brand and speaks directly to the audiences it's built for

  • Execute with purpose and precision: every campaign, launch and piece of content should have a clear reason to exist and a clear standard it's held to.

  • Set and protect a language standard that is parsimonious and human: no jargon, no filler, no vague futurism, just clear, confident writing that respects the reader.

Digital, Creative & Content Oversight

  • Oversee digital, creative, events, and content, ensuring every output is intentional, high quality and unmistakably Faculty.

  • Direct creative development across campaigns, visual identity applications, video and design, holding a high bar for craft.

  • Partner with the Head of Storytelling - who owns thought leadership and the lab-driven POV - to ensure content and creative output reinforce the same brand narrative and a consistent standard of storytelling.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing and Communications Leadership to develop and deliver integrated strategies.

  • Lead, coach and develop a team spanning digital, events, creative and brand disciplines, raising individual capability while staying hands-on where your own judgement adds most value.

  • Bring bold ideas, energy and vision, challenging marketing orthodoxies to bring Faculty marketing to a new level

  • Lead the team to become truly AI-native - using AI tools to work faster and push craft further, as well as identifying opportunities to deploy AI-enabled marketing tools and skills across the business

  • Support the international expansion of the Faculty brand, working with regional colleagues to ensure it travels well and adapts where it needs to.

Who we're looking for

  • Significant experience in the technology / AI space

  • Proven ability to build and own a brand strategy for a technology brand, from foundational narratives through to visual identity and tone of voice

  • A proven ability to find the story in complex, technical material and tell it with clarity, confidence and a genuine point of view, with an instinct for which formats will make it land.

  • Experience co-creating and owning a marketing plan tightly aligned to business strategy, translating ambition into a deliverable, resourced plan.

  • A strong eye and a high bar. Experience directing creatives, designers and agencies to produce work that is sharp and distinctive.

  • A track record of holding a team to intentional, deliberate and precise execution: premium assets, purposeful campaigns, and writing that is parsimonious and human

  • Experience owning a company's digital platforms and driving brand equity, not just lead volume.

  • Comfortable partnering with editorial and content leads to ensure output reinforces brand positioning and a consistent point of view.

  • A sharp instinct for what makes a brand distinctive in a crowded category, and the conviction to say no to generic execution.

  • Skilled at working alongside C-suite leaders and technical experts, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and a bias for delivery.

  • An ability to operate at the upper echelons of a business, and to show how brand and marketing strategy is aligned to commercial goals and actively helping achieve them.

  • Proven ability to lead, coach and develop a multi-disciplinary team. A player-coach who neither hides behind the team nor bottlenecks it.

  • Deep understanding of AI, its transformative potential when deployed at enterprise and government scale, its associated risks, and the current landscape of global AI policy and safety discourse.

  • Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  • Introduction interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  • Panel Interview (60 mins)

  • Meet the team (60 mins)

  • Final Stage Interview with the CCO (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

data.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

The Opportunity

Yepoda is growing fast across Europe and expanding internationally, and we're building our first field team. This is your chance to be part of it from day one.

You'll be Yepoda's representative inside Sephora UK, not a Beauty Advisor, but a field based commercial role. You'll drive sell-out in your doors, train and coach Sephora's Beauty Advisor teams, own the store relationships, and keep our brand presentation flawless in store.   • Hours: Full-time, 5 days a week, including weekend coverage. Schedule is confirmed upon employment start, and seasonal adjustments will be mutually agreed.

  • Travel: Up to 20% of your time, subject to change by season and business needs. Covers your doors plus occasional support at Yepoda events. Yepoda will cover travel expenses (accommodation, transportation, and meal allowance).

  • Location: London, UK. Field-based retail role (in-store at assigned Sephora location, mobile as needed)

  • Sell side by side with Sephora Beauty Advisors to lift conversion and basket size

Your Profile

  • A track record of driving sell-out in a retail environment

  • Confident delivering training, in-store events, and product demonstrations to a floor team

  • Commercially minded and customer centric with excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Genuinely self directed and highly organised, you run your doors and own your reporting

  • Passionate about skincare with real energy for the floor, K-Beauty knowledge is a big plus

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go is a platform for building and deploying custom AI agents, made for the document-heavy work finance and insurance teams handle every day. It takes multi-modal data and returns verifiable outputs with transparent logic, so accuracy and compliance come built in. It runs on the latest models too, including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Have a look at what we're building for finance and insurance.

Most AI agents still behave like black boxes. They wander off-task, miss the context that matters, and make calls you can't check. Go Agents are different: predictable, transparent, and auditable at every step.

  • Build custom AI workflows with controlled analysis at every stage. Every output comes with citations and a full audit trail, so the human in the loop can see exactly how it got there.

  • The Context Graph makes all your data (across workflows, documents and integrations) queryable in one place, giving your agents the context to be properly useful. It's your institutional memory.

The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have

  • A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products.

  • We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work.

  • We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon

  • Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control.

What you’ll be doing from day one:

  • Owning our infrastructure as code in Terraform, plus alerting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana) and reliability, including load testing and disaster recovery exercises.

  • Making CI/CD faster (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and taking obstacles out of engineers’ way, from build times to how they run AI agents day to day.

  • Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost.

  • Getting on calls with enterprise customers and our commercial team to troubleshoot and answer infrastructure and security questions. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation.

Who you are

  • Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud.

  • Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn).

  • A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers.

  • Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

Compensation: £100K – £125K • Offers Equity

data.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the role

We're hiring our first Demand Generation Lead for EMEA, Middle East and Emerging Markets. You'll own how LangSmith shows up in the region and how that turns into pipeline from partnering with performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, integrated campaigns and webinars to build a localized campaigns.

You'll be deciding what works in the region, run the experiments to prove it, and then scale what works into a repeatable regional playbook. You’ll be a builder with central support from our US demand gen, product marketing, and marketing ops teams.

Location: London or Amsterdam (one of our EMEA office hubs).

What you'll own

Regional demand strategy and pipeline

  • Build the EMEA demand plan: which markets, which segments, which channels, and what each is expected to return

  • Own an EMEA pipeline target and report against it sourced and influenced, by channel and by market

  • Decide how the regional demand budget gets allocated for localized programs.

Full-funnel program execution

You'll own the whole mix for the region and be hands-on in all of it:

  • Paid digital: partner with performance marketing to support localized 3rd party promotion, paid search, paid social, and retargeting strategy, including account-level and contact-level targeting to give sellers air cover in named accounts

  • Webinars: run a regional cadence across live demos, thought leadership webinars, technical workshops, and customer stories, in local time zones with local speakers where it helps

  • Integrated campaigns: adapt global LangSmith narratives and build region-first campaigns when the market needs something different

  • Lifecycle: build segmented nurtures and post-event follow-up for regional leads, with attention to language and time zone.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work directly with EMEA AEs and SDRs to understand what converts in-region and co-design follow-up plays that drive pipeline.

  • Partner closely with Field Marketing to build joint regional plans, align priorities, and create a coordinated interface into the sales team.

  • Support new-hire ramp by identifying warm signals, share campaign hand-off details, marketing programs, and proven outreach plays reps can use in their first 90 days.

  • Collaborate with RevOps on targeting, routing, campaign tracking, and reporting to improve regional execution and pipeline visibility.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated campaigns, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, or technical SaaS

  • Track record of building demand programs in EMEA across multiple countries, with a clear view of where localization matters and where it doesn't

  • You've personally run paid, webinars, lifecycle, and ABM

  • You write the copy, build the landing page, pull the report, and launch the campaign

  • Comfortable with a technical product and a technical audience. You don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold a conversation about agents, evals, and observability without a script

  • Strong partner to Sales. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with AEs and SDRs and you're comfortable with a pipeline number

  • Fluent in the numbers: funnel conversion, CPL, cost per SQO, pipeline contribution, and attribution's real limits

  • Working command of a modern stack, Hubspot, Influ2, Qualified, Goldcast, Zoom Webinar, Zapier, SFDC, Reo.dev, and Clay

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and true ownership

  • Salary Range: 95,000 GPB - 125,000 GBP + Equity

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.
