Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.

This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.

You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.

At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.

If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

  • Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

  • Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

  • Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

  • Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

  • Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 

Your Qualifications

  • You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

  • You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

data.title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
data.description:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

  • Visa sponsorship: Yes

data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Business Automation Engineer

As part of the Customer Care Service Design team, a Business Automation Engineer is responsible for identifying operational inefficiencies and transforming manual processes into scalable, automated solutions that improve how our teams work.

He/She leverages a combination of workflow automation, data platforms, cloud technologies, and emerging AI capabilities to build reliable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve operational consistency, and enable Customer Care teams to scale efficiently.

Working closely with stakeholders across Customer Care, Product, Engineering, and other business functions, the Business Automation Engineer translates operational challenges into practical automation opportunities and delivers solutions using our supported technology stack, including Make.com, Airtable, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Zendesk, and emerging AI-powered tools.

Their work alternates between supporting the day-to-day stability of our tooling ecosystem and delivering roadmap initiatives that improve operational efficiency, automation maturity, and user experience.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain automation solutions

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy automations that eliminate manual work and improve operational efficiency.

  • Maintain and enhance existing automations, integrations, and workflows to ensure reliability and scalability.

  • Troubleshoot issues and provide ongoing support for deployed solutions.

Translate operational needs into technical solutions

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand pain points, process gaps, and operational challenges.

  • Convert business requirements into clear automation designs and implementation plans.

  • Balance speed, simplicity, and long-term maintainability when designing solutions.

Leverage our automation and AI ecosystem

  • Build solutions using supported enterprise platforms including Make.com, Airtable, AWS, Zendesk, and approved AI technologies.

  • Explore opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities and intelligent automation where they can improve operational outcomes.

  • Support experimentation and validation of new technologies that could increase automation maturity across the organization.



Support strategic initiatives

  • Contribute technical expertise to roadmap projects and cross-functional initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Tooling, Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver automation solutions aligned with business objectives.

  • Help ensure solutions are documented, maintainable, and scalable.

Success Looks Like

  • Manual effort is reduced through reliable automation.

  • Solutions are adopted and valued by internal users.

  • Automations require minimal ongoing maintenance after deployment.

  • Operational inefficiencies are proactively identified and addressed.

  • Roadmap initiatives are delivered successfully and sustainably.

  • AI and automation opportunities are evaluated pragmatically and implemented where they provide measurable value.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

data.title: Product Support Analyst I
data.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The ideal candidate holds a degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, or a related field, although equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Candidates should have at least two years of experience in technical support, ideally within Fintech, Banking, Financial Services, or another technically complex environment.

Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience supporting gateways and card processing, troubleshooting APIs and integration errors, investigating logs and data, and diagnosing transaction issues. They should be able to interpret technical evidence, identify patterns, and apply a structured approach to problem solving. Strong communication skills are essential, as the role involves managing complex merchant enquiries and collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders.

The merchant is always at the centre of our work. We are looking for people with experience in, and a genuine desire to work in, customer support, helping merchants remove blockers and improve their results. Successful candidates demonstrate ownership, a strong sense of urgency, technical curiosity, and a commitment to quality. Comprehensive payments training will be provided, so prior payments experience is not required where the candidate has a strong technical support and troubleshooting foundation.

The Team

Merchant Product Support is a specialised global technical support function that sits between frontline support and specialist Product or Engineering teams in the ticket flow. Our analysts are product specialists aligned to defined Checkout.com product areas and features. They work closely with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, improve product functionality, and strengthen the support experience for each product area.

The team is primarily centred in London, with a strategic regional presence in Dublin, Mexico, Dubai, and Shanghai. This distribution provides broad coverage across multiple time zones and enables specialised support for merchants and internal teams.

We are passionate about technology and use state-of-the-art AI capabilities to create better outcomes for our customers. We look for people who are curious, open to new ways of working, and eager to use AI as builders from the outset. Team members are encouraged to develop and improve AI-enabled tools that make technical investigations more effective and help accelerate solutions.

Role Overview

The Analyst I is the foundational specialist tier within Merchant Product Support. The role receives and manages merchant and internal requests across channels such as instant messaging, email, and web forms. Analysts acknowledge requests, investigate and resolve issues within their product scope, apply documented technical procedures, provide clear updates, and work in line with agreed SLAs and quality standards. When an issue requires deeper expertise, they engage the appropriate internal team or escalate to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst with clear evidence and relevant troubleshooting details.

Troubleshooting is at the core of the role. Analysts investigate payment flows, system logs, transaction data, and other technical evidence to diagnose issues, identify recurring patterns, and understand emerging trends. Areas of investigation may include advanced financial investigations, payment transaction anomalies, REST API and integration errors, webhook failures, Vault and tokenisation issues, authentication, fraud detection logic, gateway and card processing issues, platform errors, and changes in payment performance or authorisation rates. The team also supports issues affecting payment methods such as PayPal, KNET, Klarna, SEPA, MB WAY, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

This is a specialist role supported by targeted training designed to build deep expertise in payment flows and enable consistently high-quality problem solving. Analysts use advanced tools and techniques for technical investigation and API debugging while developing the knowledge required to resolve issues efficiently and help merchants maintain successful payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Ticket Management: Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system; remain logged in and active during working hours.

  • Customer Support: Acknowledge, investigate, and respond to merchant inquiries via the ticketing system, as well as internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.

  • Investigation & Escalation: Perform initial investigations; refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate.

  • Knowledge Management: Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation updated.

  • Product Expertise: Maintain a solid understanding of products, services, and policies to provide accurate information.

  • Quality Assurance: Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimize errors and provide consistent care.

  • Issue Identification: Categorize global queue issues and identify repetitive problems, escalating the likely root causes to the wider team.

  • Process Improvement: Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Product Onboarding: Actively participate in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our FinCrime AML/CTF Manager, you'll lead, grow, and manage our 1st line AML/CTF operations team, translating compliance policies into smooth, actionable risk management processes across the entire customer lifecycle.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Customer Risk Management - Owning and maintaining the Customer Risk Assessment Frameworks, ensuring risk scoring and categorisation accurately reflect financial crime realities.

  • Lifecycle & Periodic Reviews - Leading periodic and event-driven reviews across the customer portfolio to dynamically reassess customer risk categorisations.

  • Oversight of Due Diligence Activities - Overseeing onboarding and ongoing monitoring activities executed by KYC and KYB teams, aligning internal controls with regulatory expectations.

  • Product Requirements & UX Optimisation - Partnering closely with Product teams to define actionable onboarding requirements that balance regulatory compliance with a frictionless user experience.

  • Surveillance & Detection Management - Overseeing end-to-end transaction monitoring for all AML/CTF typologies, including timely assessments, escalations, and scenario calibrations.

  • Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management - Mentoring and scaling a team of AML/CTF analysts, driving operational excellence, and regularly reporting risk metrics to senior management.

  • Compliance Translation - Acting as the primary liaison to the 2nd Line Compliance team, proactively translating regulatory updates into scalable operational workflows.

  • Reporting to the FIU - Serving as the final 1st line approver for Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs).

  • Audit & Regulatory Liaison - Preparing operational documentation and data for internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and inquiries from competent authorities.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone equipped with strong leadership, deep regulatory mastery, and an operational mindset to protect our ecosystem against financial crime.

  • Experience - 6+ years in AML/CTF operations within Fintech, digital banking, or payment processing environments, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing dedicated teams.

  • Regulatory Knowledge - Profound understanding of EU AML Directives and FATF recommendations, with strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulatory requirements (knowledge of Italian regulations is a plus).

  • Certifications - Professional certification such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent is highly expected.

  • Operational Framework Mastery - Proven track record managing transaction monitoring systems, reviewing/approving SARs/STRs, and designing practical customer risk-rating frameworks.

  • Stakeholder & Communication Skills - Exceptional ability to negotiate, collaborate across functions, and liaise seamlessly with 2nd line compliance teams.

  • Data-Driven Leadership - Strong analytical mindset capable of leveraging KPIs and data tools (such as HEX, SQL, or Splunk) to optimize operational queues and assess resource needs.

  • Change Management Mindset - Agility to lead teams through hyper-growth, shifting regulations, and tech upgrades while maintaining high morale and performance.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

* We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Coacher les autres membres de l’équipe et se partager les bonnes pratiques. 

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule ! 

  • Tu vis dans le Sud de la France, autour de Montpellier, Marseille, Toulon ou Nice ;

  •  Tu as +3 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseigne ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ; tu sais gérer des deals complexes ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu aimes guider et mentorer des collaborateurs juniors pour les accompagner et développer leur autonomie au quotidien ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Beyond day-to-day operations, you will have the opportunity to shape and continuously improve Lengow’s Corporate IT environment, with real ownership over how our tools, infrastructure and processes evolve.

Your main responsabilities:

🛠️ IT operations and user support

  • Ensure the continuity and quality of internal IT services.
  • Manage and prioritise support requests and operational incidents.
  • Support employees across Windows, macOS and Linux environments.
  • Coordinate escalations with software, hardware and service providers.
  • Define and monitor service levels, recurring incidents and operational priorities.
  • Support and guide the IT apprentice in daily operations.

🔑 Identity, endpoint and asset management

  • Administer Google Workspace, Active Directory and the main corporate SaaS applications.
  • Manage the complete lifecycle of user accounts, including groups, roles and permissions.
  • Maintain and improve SSO, MFA and role-based access management.
  • Manage endpoint configuration, patching, encryption, antivirus and device compliance.
  • Manage the lifecycle and inventory of laptops, mobile devices and IT equipment.
  • Prepare and improve employee onboarding and offboarding workflows.

🌐 Network and infrastructure

  • Operate and maintain the internal network infrastructure across the Nantes, Paris and Barcelona offices.
  • Administer network infrastructure including switching, routing, Wi-Fi, VLANs, firewalls and access-control systems.
  • Operate Lengow’s internal infrastructure hosted primarily on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Administer Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and LDAP/LDAPS and related identity services.
  • Maintain secure remote access and connectivity between users, offices and cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot network, system and connectivity incidents.

🔐 Security and compliance

  • Maintain endpoint security, patching, encryption and vulnerability-remediation processes.
  • Monitor the security status and compliance of employee devices.
  • Support the response to internal security incidents and remediation plans.
  • Maintain security procedures and participate in continuity and recovery tests.
  • Contribute to customer security questionnaires, audits and due-diligence requests.

🚀 SaaS, vendors and projects

  • Administer and maintain Lengow’s portfolio of internal SaaS applications.
  • Manage IT contracts, licences, renewals and supplier relationships.
  • Negotiate with vendors and challenge technical and commercial proposals.
  • Monitor IT spend and identify opportunities to simplify the toolset and reduce recurring costs.
  • Lead Corporate IT projects and continue the modernisation and standardisation of Lengow’s IT environment.
  • Improve processes and automation, maintain documentation and build the Corporate IT roadmap with the CTO.

🪜 Hiring Process:

  • HR video call with Inchela, our HR Business Partner
  • Technical & Manager interview with Alexis, our current IT manager, and Olivier, our CPTO and manager of this role
  • Job offer 🎉

Requirements

Experience

We’re looking for someone with ideally 4+ years of experience in Corporate IT, systems or infrastructure roles, who has taken ownership of an internal IT environment and is comfortable combining hands-on IT operations with infrastructure and improvement projects. You should also have experience working with external IT providers and operating in a multi-site environment, supporting employees both locally and remotely, ideally across different countries. Candidates with fewer than 4 years may also be considered if they demonstrate strong expertise across the essential technical areas below. 

Essential technical skills

  • Strong administration skills in an enterprise collaboration environment such as Google Workspace and Microsoft Active Directory, including DNS, DHCP and LDAP
  • Good knowledge of identity and access management, including SSO, SAML, MFA and role-based access
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and good operational knowledge of macOS and Linux
  • Experience with endpoint management and security, including patching, encryption and antivirus solutions
  • Strong networking fundamentals: switching, routing, VLANs, Wi-Fi, firewalls and VPN/ZTNA technologies
  • Knowledge of IT asset management and IT service management processes
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, network, endpoint and identity issues

What will help you succeed

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hands-on mindset, with the ability to investigate and solve issues directly
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with internal users and external providers, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

Languages

Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

What You'll Do

Product Management

  • Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

  • Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.

  • Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.

  • Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.

  • Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.

  • Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.

  • Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

Execution and Individual Contribution

  • Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.

  • Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.

  • Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.

Who You Are

data.title: UX/UI Designer | Intch
data.description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

What you will work on

  • Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

  • Take a task from an open question to a production ready design.

  • Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

  • Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products.

  • Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

What matters for this role

  • Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

  • Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch.

  • The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste.

  • Openness to evidence and the confidence to change your mind when a better argument appears.

  • Experience owning design from an unclear problem through to launch.

  • Comfort working with autonomy in a small product company.

  • Experience in a startup, as a founding designer or in an in-house product role, would be useful.

  • A practical approach to AI tools. The current workflow includes Figma handoff and clickable prototypes in Claude. Production code is not expected.

  • English at B1, fluent Russian.

What you get

  • Remote, open geography. Time zone overlap with ~CET is what matters.

  • Flexible schedule. Paid vacation, sick leave, and days off.

  • A flat team under 40 where you can bring a worked-out idea into any product — and get paid for it if it performs.

  • A design problem the market hasn't solved yet, in a product used across 140 countries.

  • Real autonomy from day one. You'll sit in product discussions, not receive tickets.

We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to take the Photoroom app to the next level for the millions of people who use it every day. You'll own features from architecture to polished interface, ship weekly, and help shape the product roadmap while collaborating closely with Engineering Management, Design, and Product.

Compensation: €90k-110k depending on experience + BSPCE

Location: Paris, France, with an in-office presence 3 days per week.

This is a Paris- or Île-de-France-based role, and we do not accept remote applications. We offer substantial relocation support (€10k signing bonus), including help finding an apartment in Paris and visa assistance.

About the Role

  • Build and ship new features for an app used and loved by millions, regularly featured by Apple, with a 4.8 App Store rating.

  • Own your work from A to Z, from architecture and coding to polishing top-notch interfaces that deliver a delightful user experience.

  • Ship a new version of the app every week, follow product usage closely, and make decisions based on fast user feedback.

  • Shape the product roadmap and new features together with Engineering Management, Design, and Product.

  • Raise the bar for the whole team through your code, your reviews, and by sharing your knowledge and experience, while learning or deepening your knowledge of technologies like Metal, Core Image, and CoreML.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience on iOS, mostly on consumer apps.

  • Strong experience with Swift and modern frameworks.

  • You care deeply about user experience and have shipped interfaces you are proud of.

  • Strong sense of ownership: you take initiative and are comfortable making product and technical decisions.

  • Pragmatic and iteration-driven: you favor speed of iteration over perfection and believe fast iteration is the best way to learn.

  • Fluent in English (French is not required).

  • [Nice-to-have] Curious about the latest trends in the iOS ecosystem and active in the community (Do iOS, Swift Connection, etc.).

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Benefits

  • Regular team gatherings, including in-person onboarding in Paris (1-2 weeks), yearly company offsite and team retreat, quarterly in-person meetings (monthly during probation period), and social events like winter party and hackathons.

  • 25 days annual leave + RTT on top of local public holidays

  • Competitive equity package with BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

  • €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development

  • Private health insurance

  • Access to personalized mental health support, including 1:1 sessions with therapists or coaches, self-care tools, and well-being resources via MokaCare

  • Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

  • Language lessons (English and French) for those who need them. Photoroom is an international team, and we work in English.

  • Relocation support (up to €10k) available for those choosing to move to France, including apartment finding and visa assistance.

Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for positions based in France.

Hiring Process

  1. Screening call with Talent Manager (30min)

  2. Technical interview with Hiring Manager (45min)

  3. Take-home assignment (4 hours) and live review with the team (45min)

  4. Culture fit interviews and meet the team (~3h in total)

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

data.title: Alternance - Commercial·e / Sales / Business Developer
data.description:
Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat.

Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution.

En tant qu’alternant·e Sales Development Representative, tu es le premier point de contact et le premier maillon de notre chaîne commerciale. Ton rôle est stratégique : transformer l’intérêt d’un prospect en une opportunité commerciale réelle pour les Account Executives.

Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Tes missions :

  • Réaliser les premiers appels téléphoniques avec les prospects qui ont demandé un devis sur notre site. Tu devras être réactif·ve pour instaurer rapidement une relation de confiance avec tes prospects,

  • Comprendre les problématiques rencontrées au sein de leur copropriété, les convaincre que Matera est la bonne solution pour eux et lever les premiers freins,

  • Organiser des rendez-vous de démonstration avec les Account Executive

  • Tenir à jour le CRM Hubspot

  • Participer à des projets d’amélioration de processus et d’organisation du travail

  • Assister les Account Executives dans leurs missions du quotidien (suivi des prospects, tenue d’assemblées générales, soutien administratif…)

Déroulement de l’alternance :

Ton parcours d’intégration commence par deux semaines de rencontres avec l’ensemble de nos équipes pour comprendre comment nous sommes organisés en interne et notre vision.

En tant que membre du département Sales, tu vas intégrer notre “Sales Academy” :

  • Tout au long de tes 3 premiers mois, tu seras accompagné·e sur les techniques de vente et sur la compréhension des spécificités de nos produits et cibles clients (formations techniques, ateliers pratiques, etc.). Tu auras régulièrement des meetings individuels avec taon manager pour échanger sur tes difficultés et fêter tes victoires.

  • Selon ta montée en compétences et tes appétences, tu pourras ensuite devenir formateur·trice, être force de proposition pour améliorer nos processus, ou continuer sur le cycle de vente jusqu’au closing.

À la fin de ton alternance, tu maîtriseras les techniques de vente, les cycles de vente complexes, et les meilleurs outils utilisés par les start-ups. Tu participes au lancement de nouvelles offres, ce qui te permet de comprendre comment fonctionne l’entrepreneuriat.

Les avantages :

Les plus :

  • Salaire : selon grille syntec

  • Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l’environnement start-up et immobilier,

  • Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite.

  • Wellpass pour faire du sport à petits prix

  • Tickets resto (Swile) - pris en charge à 50%

  • Accès à la plateforme Leeto pour avoir accès à des activités à prix réduit via le CSE

  • Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables,

  • Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses,

La base légale :

  • Prise en charge des transports à 50%

  • Mutuelle & Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50%

  • Prise en charge de la prévoyance à 100%

  • Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis

Informations pratiques :

  • Localisation : Paris 10e

  • Type de contrat : Alternance (un ou deux ans)

  • Date de démarrage : septembre 2026

  • Rythme obligatoire : 3 semaines en entreprise / une semaine à l’école.


Idéalement, tu :

  • Aimes trouver des solutions pour tes clients et tu aimes convaincre ton audience

  • As envie de monter en compétences et d’évoluer sur les métiers Sales

  • Recherches une alternance d’un ou deux ans et tu parles français couramment

  • Bonus : tu as déjà réalisé des jobs étudiant/ jobs d’été/ missions d’interim’ (restauration, vente, accueil, événementiel, animation, etc.)

Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ?

Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ?

Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ?

Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre !

data.title: Chef d'équipe logistique H/F /X -CDI
data.description:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE
 
Rattaché(e) au Responsable de site, vous aurez pour mission principale de diriger et de mettre en œuvre les moyens techniques et humains pour la bonne exécution du tri et la composition des lots selon la stratégie définie.
Vous serez responsable du bon fonctionnement opérationnel du site et garant d'un bon climat social.
 

🎯 MISSIONS
  • Répartir les tâches quotidiennes entre les collaborateurs et garantir leur bonne exécution dans le respect des règles d’hygiène, de sécurité et de propreté.
  • Gérer la répartition des commandes selon les priorités opérationnelles, et y participer activement.
  • Suivre les stocks avec rigueur, notamment l’adressage précis des entrées et des sorties.
  • Organiser et assurer les inventaires bi-annuels.
  • Communiquer les informations nécessaires à la planification de l’activité : suivi des consommables, remontée des anomalies ou dysfonctionnements.
  • Anticiper les contraintes d’activité et adapter les ressources en fonction de la charge et de la polyvalence des équipes.

    • 👉PRÉ REQUIS
  • Vous justifiez d’une expérience de 2 ans minimum dans un poste similaire (chef d’équipe ou référent logistique), avec une expérience confirmée d'au moins 5 ans en logistique.
  • Titulaire d’un Bac +2, vous faites preuve d’excellentes qualités relationnelles : écoute, communication, diplomatie, et capacité d’adaptation.
  • Meneur(se) d’équipe, vous savez mobiliser, animer et fédérer vos collaborateurs autour d’objectifs partagés.
  • Rigueur, sens de l’organisation, réactivité, esprit d’équipe et force de proposition sont des qualités essentielles pour réussir dans ce poste.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et connaissez les bases des systèmes WMS/WCS.
  • À l’aise avec la manutention, vous savez utiliser les engins de type gerbeur.
  • La possession des CACES 1 et 3 serait un véritable atout.

data.title: Alternance - Déclarant(e) en douane et conseil H/F/X
data.description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE
  • Au cœur de la Supply Chain et de l'unité Food & Beverage basée à Beaune, le Déclarant en douane et conseil (Alternance) assure la conformité réglementaire de nos flux de marchandises, notamment pour les vins, spiritueux et épicerie fine. 
  • En collaboration étroite avec la Coordinatrice comptabilité matière, il participe activement à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et outils douaniers, jouant un rôle clé dans la sécurisation opérationnelle et le développement international.
  •  Ce poste stratégique se situe à l'intersection de l'administration douanière, de l'opérationnel logistique et de l'analyse, nécessitant un profil rigoureux, organisé et doté d'une forte appétence pour l'univers du transport et des réglementations
  • Le titulaire gère en autonomie les déclarations douanières, le suivi de stock de comptabilité matière (droits d'accises, DAE) et la conformité fiscale des produits. Une rigueur exemplaire est requise pour assurer la fiabilité des données, notamment sur le nouvel outil, via des contrôles mensuels. Il est également force de proposition pour remonter les anomalies et feedbacks à l'équipe projet

    • 🎯 MISSIONS

    Activité 1:  Gestion des déclarations douanières et de la comptabilité matière

  • Gérer les déclarations douanières (DAE/DSAC), les titres de mouvement et le suivi de stock de comptabilité matière pour les produits Food & Beverage (vins, spiritueux, épicerie fine).

  • Assurer la conformité fiscale liée à la circulation de ces produits et l'encadrement de la facturation/administration des ventes.

    • Activité 2 : Contribution à l'amélioration continue des processus douaniers

  • Participer activement à l'échange avec l'équipe projet pour remonter les anomalies, feedbacks et proposer des améliorations sur les outils douaniers (notamment le nouvel outil en cours de déploiement).

  • Sécuriser et simplifier les processus douaniers et administratifs.

    • Activité 3 : Support et formation interne

  • Préparer des supports de formation et de vulgarisation pour faciliter la compréhension des processus douaniers.

  • Expliquer aux équipes opérationnelles les impacts des contraintes douanières.

    • Activité 4 : Veille réglementaire et développement commercial international

  • Effectuer une veille réglementaire sur les aspects douaniers et fiscaux, notamment pour les produits Food & Beverage, et alerter l'entreprise des mises à jour.

  • Participer au développement commercial vers de nouveaux pays (ex: Pays-Bas, Autriche) en étudiant les spécificités douanières et fiscales.

    • Activité 5 : Support opérationnel logistique

  • Comprendre le terrain et les opérations logistiques (réception, contrôle, expédition) pour identifier et résoudre d'éventuelles anomalies en lien avec les aspects douaniers.


    • 👉 PROFIL

    Formation et expériences professionnelles 

  • Formation Bac +2/3 validé en Transport/Logistique (TSMEL, GTLA, REL, GOL, RPTL).

  • Expériences terrains (stages/alternances précédentes) en Exploitation Transport/Affrètement, Logistique d'Entrepôt ou Service Client/Litiges.

  • Formation visée : Spécialisation Déclarant en douane (Alternance).

  • Disponibilité : Septembre 2026.

    • Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de la gestion des flux et du transport (modes de transport Maritime, Aérien, Routier, schémas logistiques, chaîne de valeur).

  • Parfaite maîtrise des Incoterms 2020.

  • Gestion documentaire (lettres de voiture, CMR, etc.).

  • Connaissances théoriques des procédures douanières (DAE/DSAC).

  • Connaissance en gestion de stocks.

  • Maîtrise de Google Sheets (extraction, tableaux).

  • Appréhension du logiciel Gamma (outil de déclaration).

    • Langues : Anglais professionnel (vocabulaire technique appliqué au transport et à la logistique).

    Compétences comportementales

  • Vision globale de la Supply Chain.

  • Rigueur et conformité.

  • Gestion de l'urgence (calme, méthode, pragmatisme face aux aléas du transport).

  • Appétence pour l'administration douanière.

  • Curiosité et esprit d'amélioration continue.

    • Autres : Permis B et véhicule personnel obligatoires.

    👉 LE PETIT PLUS

  • Appétence pour le secteur du vin, des spiritueux et de l'épicerie fine


    • ✅ AVANTAGES
  • 👉Accès au CE
  • 👉Paniers repas
  • 👉Participation et intéressement
  • 👉Chèques vacances / Chèques Noël
  • 👉Forfait mobilité durable (sous condition)
  • 👉Prime variable

    • ⚙️PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT
    1️⃣ Entretien RH en visio (30 min)
    2️⃣Entretien d’1 heure 1-to-1 avec le manager (physique ou à distance)

data.title: Engineering Manager - Java
data.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Connect team, reporting to Rémi Fouilloux, Senior Engineering Manager. The team is split between Bordeaux and Paris.

Together, you'll be building and scaling Mirakl Connect, an innovative solution that simplifies sellers' daily lives through a central hub powered by the latest advances in AI.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Your Impact

  • Drive technical excellence: Take ownership of user stories, conduct code reviews, and actively contribute to design, development, testing, and production deployments
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Develop roadmaps with R&D, align priorities with other tech leads, and partner with product and design teams to deliver on commitments with high velocity and quality
  • Develop talent and best practices: Ensure successful onboarding, identify and nurture team talent, contribute to recruitment, and establish best practices in clean code, testing, and pair programming
  • Remove blockers and enable success: Step in to resolve technical challenges, make arbitration decisions, and ensure the team delivers on its commitments
  • Lead and grow your team: Manage and mentor 4-5 developers, conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, and fostering team cohesion and motivation across distributed locations
  • Participate in the adoption of AI : within our products but also in internal practices 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of Java development experience with recent versions
  • Minimum 2 years in a team lead or similar management role, mentoring developers
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management
  • Track record of delivering complex projects in a microservices environment
  • Professional proficiency in English 

Skills:

  • Java development and architecture
  • Team leadership and mentoring
  • Technical decision-making and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clean code and engineering best practices

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute technical interview on Google Meet with an experienced developer to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge
  3. 1-hour business discussion with the Senior Engineering Manager 
  4. 2 x 45-minute STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders 

More information about our recruitment philosophy 👉 3 tips to shine in STAR interviews at Mirakl

 

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Connect team, reporting to Rémi Fouilloux, Senior Engineering Manager. The team is split between Bordeaux and Paris.

Together, you'll be building and scaling Mirakl Connect, an innovative solution that simplifies sellers' daily lives through a central hub powered by the latest advances in AI.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Your Impact

  • Drive technical excellence: Take ownership of user stories, conduct code reviews, and actively contribute to design, development, testing, and production deployments
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Develop roadmaps with R&D, align priorities with other tech leads, and partner with product and design teams to deliver on commitments with high velocity and quality
  • Develop talent and best practices: Ensure successful onboarding, identify and nurture team talent, contribute to recruitment, and establish best practices in clean code, testing, and pair programming
  • Remove blockers and enable success: Step in to resolve technical challenges, make arbitration decisions, and ensure the team delivers on its commitments
  • Lead and grow your team: Manage and mentor 4-5 developers, conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, and fostering team cohesion and motivation across distributed locations
  • Participate in the adoption of AI : within our products but also in internal practices 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of Java development experience with recent versions
  • Minimum 2 years in a team lead or similar management role, mentoring developers
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management
  • Track record of delivering complex projects in a microservices environment
  • Professional proficiency in English 

Skills:

  • Java development and architecture
  • Team leadership and mentoring
  • Technical decision-making and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clean code and engineering best practices

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute technical interview on Google Meet with an experienced developer to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge
  3. 1-hour business discussion with the Senior Engineering Manager 
  4. 2 x 45-minute STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders 

More information about our recruitment philosophy 👉 3 tips to shine in STAR interviews at Mirakl

 

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

data.title: Démonstratrice Lingerie - Printemps Lyon (Alternance)
data.description:
Introduction

Vous rêvez d’un rôle alliant élégance, expertise et passion ? Van de Velde, le groupe belge à l'origine des célèbres marques de lingerie haut de gamme PrimaDonna, Marie Jo et Sarda, recherche une démonstratrice dynamique et passionnée pour représenter ses collections premium au Printemps Haussmann. 

Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans l’industrie de la lingerie de luxe, Van de Velde est un leader mondial reconnu pour son savoir-faire exceptionnel, son engagement envers le confort et ses créations innovantes. En tant que démonstratrice, vous jouerez un rôle clé en faisant découvrir la sophistication et le luxe de nos produits à une clientèle exigeante, tout en incarnant les valeurs de nos marques prestigieuses. 

Notre raison d'être : "We ignite the power in women" 
Chez Van de Velde, notre raison d’être est simple et puissante : "Nous éveillons le pouvoir des femmes." Cette mission s’appuie sur nos valeurs fondamentales : 

  • Portés par la passion 

  • Nous respirons la qualité 

  • Nous sommes authentiques 

  • Nous nous concentrons sur les consommateurs et les clients 

  • Nous sommes entreprenants 

  • Ensemble, nous sommes forts 

Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d’une équipe professionnelle et passionnée, engagée pour l'excellence, avec plus de 1 500 collaborateurs à travers le monde. C’est l’opportunité de contribuer à une marque qui œuvre pour l’autonomisation des femmes et leur beauté depuis plus d’un siècle. 


Missions:

  • Vendre les marques en mettant en avant leur savoir-faire, leur qualité et leur raffinement.

  • Offrir une expérience d'achat unique en magasin, où chaque cliente bénéficie d'un service personnalisé et d'une attention particulière.

  • Accueillir et enthousiasmer les clientes en les abordant dès leur entrée dans l’espace dédié.

  • Fournir des conseils personnalisés en lingerie en cabine d’essayage pour chaque cliente.

  • Mettre en valeur les produits en assurant la présentation soignée du stand et en veillant à ce que l’espace de vente soit toujours impeccable et accueillant.

  • Maintenir un stock suffisant pour le bon fonctionnement de l’espace de vente et répondre à la demande des clientes.

  • Informer les clientes sur les produits, leurs caractéristiques et avantages, tout en partageant l’histoire et les valeurs de nos marques.

  • Assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec l'équipe du Printemps pour garantir une parfaite collaboration.

Profil recherché

  • Vous avez une passion pour la mode et la lingerie haut de gamme, et vous êtes capable de transmettre cette passion à vos clientes.

  • Vous possédez une expérience préalable dans la vente, idéalement dans le secteur de la lingerie.

  • Vous êtes doté(e) d'une excellente présentation et d’un sens aigu du service client, avec une capacité à écouter, comprendre et conseiller efficacement.

  • Vous êtes dynamique, autonome et à l'aise dans un environnement de vente exigeant.

  • Vous avez une énergie positive et détectez toujours des opportunités pour mettre davantage en avant nos marques sur la surface de vente.

  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance des tendances et êtes à l’aise avec l’évolution des attentes de la clientèle.

  • Vous avez une forte orientation résultats et êtes motivé(e) à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs commerciaux.

Notre Offre:

  • Un contrat d’apprentissage.  

  • Un environnement de travail autonome (shop-in-shop) avec un encadrement et un soutien personnel adaptés. 

  • Une formation complète en lingerie styling et en connaissance produit des marques dont vous pourrez être fier(ère). 

  • Une rémunération attractive, avec une prime trimestrielle liée à vos performances. 

  • Un planning respectueux de votre équilibre vie professionnelle-vie personnelle. 

Postulez dès maintenant pour rejoindre notre équipe et faire rayonner l’univers de PrimaDonna et Sarda dans l’un des magasins les plus prestigieux de Lyon.

data.description:
Nous recherchons un stagiaire de fin d’études pour accompagner le renforcement de l’équipe Real Estate Services / Immobilier.


Vous serez amené(e)s à intervenir sur des missions de conseil financier spécialisé en immobilier pour le compte de fonds d’investissement, de foncières ou de comptes corporate (missions de Transactions Services, modélisation et structuration de dossiers d’investissement immobiliers, réalisation de business plans, évaluation…).


Vous pourrez également participer à des missions de conseils stratégiques et opérationnelles (plan de performance et d’économies, arbitrages, stratégie de développement, évaluation d’actifs en reconversion, …).


Vous serez pleinement impliqué dans toutes les étapes de la mission et participerez à des réunions avec le client ou les autres conseils intervenant sur le projet (avocats, banquiers…). Les membres de la mission (du senior à l’associé) participeront à votre formation au quotidien afin de vous aider à acquérir toutes les connaissances techniques vous permettant de devenir rapidement autonome dans la réalisation de vos travaux.


Nous recherchons un stagiaire de fin d'études issu(e)s des meilleures grandes écoles et universités (Commerce, Ingénieur) disposant d’une première expérience en audit, en conseil financier, en banque d’affaires ou en direction financière.

Disponible, rigoureux et organisé, vous savez vous adapter très rapidement aux missions qui vous sont confiées et disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse. Vous pratiquez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Vous souhaitez vous spécialiser en immobilier.

Ce stage se déroulera pendant 6 mois à partir de Septembre / Octobre 2025.

Enfin, vous êtes particulièrement motivé(e) à rejoindre l’aventure Eight Advisory !
